_doc: Revert-verify mutants for `query --prune-report` — the report module (RFC 308a52c3 «Загрузка по запросу» Д1, phase 1b, vault-exodev task dc5ed554). Each mutant is a plausible wrong implementation of ONE guarantee of query-prune-report.ts and reddens exactly `expect` (pairwise distinct sets; measured by mutant-driver, control 0, 2026-11-14; P15–P23 and F13–F14 — the wrong implementations found by the independent review of the specification). The flag wiring in sparql-query.ts has its own spec (query-prune-report-dc5ed554.flag.spec.json). The analysis input (the translator's algebra BEFORE the optimizer) has no mutant: no input is known where the optimizer changes the analyzer's verdict — the contract is the analyzer's, the oracle locks its own use (O22). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145).

P1_share_counts_unique_triples.from: for (const t of triples) if (analysis.predicates.has(t.predicate.value)) triplesCut += 1;
P1_share_counts_unique_triples._note: the cut counted as the deduplicated store (the oracle's cutTriples unit): R7, whose fixture carries duplicates under P' (a symbolic status value linked from two files). R19 also reddens: it requires the entry's triplesCut to equal the (raw) union count.

P2_namespace_mode_never._note: the namespace label never fires: VL-3's mode name (R2) and the batch mode count (R12). R17 (the mixed query) loses the label too.

P3_full_share_zero._note: a full load reported as share 0: the text (R3), the JSON (R4), the batch median that counts a full load as 1 (R12).

P4_median_drops_full._note: the median skips full loads — the RFC criterion counts them (R12).

P5_union_ignores_full._note: one full entry no longer makes the batch union full (R13).

P6_update_not_refused._note: an UPDATE is analyzed (full load «update») instead of refused as query --batch refuses it (R14).

P7_no_store_predicates._note: no predicate list in the context: VL-3 falls back to full load (namespace-filter-without-predicate-list) — R2, the batch counts (R12) and the pruned union (R13). R17 (mixed) and R24 (namespace query on the empty graph) fall back to full load as well.

P8_no_sub_property_index._note: no sub-property index: the closure and its declarations leave P' (R5); R12 reddens through its non-vacuity guard (the two medians coincide once the sub-property entry shrinks). R21 reddens through its guard «≥ 3 predicates» (the sub-property query keeps only its own predicate).

P9_sources_unsorted._note: sources in discovery order: Class_superClass reads [query, class-bridge] (R6) — the output order is deterministic by design.

P10_variable_without_mark._note: the variable of a reason printed without '?' (R3).

P11_json_without_type._note: the JSON document loses data.type (R8). R23 reads data.type of the template report.

P12_single_ignores_use_cache.from: const loaded = await loadVaultTriples(vaultPath, { useCache: options.useCache });
P12_single_ignores_use_cache.to: const loaded = await loadVaultTriples(vaultPath, { useCache: false });
P12_single_ignores_use_cache._note: the single report ignores --use-cache (R15); the flag spec's F6 reddens the same axis one link earlier (the wiring) — producer and consumer of one value.

P13_median_even_takes_upper._note: the median of an even count takes the upper middle value: R16 and the 4-entry batch of R12.

P14_percent_one_decimal._note: the text share loses its second decimal: R1 and R3 pin the printed line.

P15_namespace_mode_every._note: `every` instead of `some`: a constant beside a namespace filter loses the label (R17 — found by the spec review; the live corpus has no mixed query). R24 too: `every` over the EMPTY P' of the empty graph is vacuously true ⇒ prune-namespace instead of prune.

P16_union_cut_summed.from: for (const t of triples) if (union.has(t.predicate.value)) cut += 1;
P16_union_cut_summed.to: cut = Math.round(pruneShares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) * triples.length);
P16_union_cut_summed._note: the union counted as the SUM of the entries' shares: overlapping entries count twice (R18).

P17_union_cut_dedup.from: for (const t of triples) if (union.has(t.predicate.value)) cut += 1;
P17_union_cut_dedup._note: the union counted without duplicates — the oracle-unit mix, in the union (R19).

P18_union_skips_skeletons.to: for (const p of analysis.predicates) if ([...(analysis.sources.get(p) ?? [])].some((s) => s === "query" || s === "namespace-filter")) union.add(p);
P18_union_skips_skeletons._note: the union keeps only the query's own and namespace predicates: the sub-property skeleton (R20) and the class-bridge skeleton of the membership entry (R19) drop out.

P20_batch_record_trimmed.from: record = { type: "prune-report", name: entry.name, ok: true, ...report };
P20_batch_record_trimmed.to: record = { type: "prune-report", name: entry.name, ok: true, mode: report.mode, share: report.share };
P20_batch_record_trimmed._note: a batch record without P', reasons and counts (R22); R19 and R20 read the entry's triplesCut.

P21_single_executes_query.from: const report = pruneReport(analyze(ast, await analysisContext(store, loaded.triples)), loaded.triples);
P21_single_executes_query.to:
const report = pruneReport(analyze(ast, await analysisContext(store, loaded.triples)), loaded.triples);
  await new (await import("@kitelev/exocortex-core")).ExoQLQueryExecutor(store).executeAll(new ExoQLAlgebraTranslator().translate(ast as never));
P21_single_executes_query._note: a hidden execution after the report — nothing printed, the executor called (R10: found by the spec review). R27 too: the hidden executeAll throws on the UPDATE (the translator has no update algebra).

P22_empty_graph_share_one._note: an empty graph reports a prune as share 1 (R24).

P23_analysis_error_as_syntax._note: a failed analysis typed as a syntax error (R25).
